camps.description: Southwest Florida Council's 1,200-acre Scout camp on the Price-Sanders Scout Reservation near Punta Gorda, with pool, rifle/shotgun/archery/BB ranges, climbing wall, rappelling tower, ropes course and waterfront. Hosts the council's Scouts BSA resident (Winter) camp program; published 2026 summer session dates were not cleanly available.
